name: Autorender
description: Autorender is image and video infrastructure built for AI app builders — reliable uploads, fast CDN delivery, and storage/optimization handled for you. This connector brings your real Autorender library into your workflow: browse and search files by folder or tag, upload new images and video (including large files via multipart upload), organize folders, and update metadata — all against your actual account data, not mock placeholders. Every call runs through your own Autorender API key via OAuth, so builds use real CDN URLs from the start instead of stand-in images.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Autorender to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Autorender to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api-mcp.autorender.io/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Autorender MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Autorender lists 13 MCP tools, including create_folder, delete_file, delete_folder, get_file, list_files, list_folders, multipart_complete, multipart_start, multipart_upload_part, rename_file, rename_folder, and update_file.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Autorender?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Autorender in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Autorender requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Autorender is developed by Autorender. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
